children: Helix Energy Solutions Group Inc. (HLX) filed a Form 8K - Termination of a Definitive Agreement - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 01, 2026.
Termination of Helix ABL Credit Facility

At the Effective Time, Helix terminated its existing $120 million asset-based credit agreement, dated as of September 30, 2021 (as amended, the "Helix ABL Facility"), with Bank of America, N.A., as agent, and the financial institutions party thereto as lenders. In connection with the termination, the liens and guarantees securing the Helix ABL Facility were released. There were no outstanding borrowings under the Helix ABL Facility.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/866829/000119312526378529/d102206d8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/866829/000119312526378529/0001193125-26-378529-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
